'''Dorn Sevelle''' was a trade [[Baron/Legends|baron]] of the [[Karazak Slavers' Cooperative/Legends|Karazak Slavers Cooperative]]. At some point during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], Sevelle and his group of slavers were stationed on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kowak/Legends|Kowak]], a slaver safe-heaven operated by the [[Zygerrian/Legends|Zygerrian]] [[Prince/Legends|Prince]] [[Sono Molec/Legends|Sono Molec]]. During this time, Sevelle won a bet against Molec, winning ownership over Molec's gladiator champion, the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Nam Beroya/Legends|Nam Beroya]], a.k.a. "The Prince's Sword." However, Molec hired a group of [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] [[Agent/Legends|agents]] to retrieve his prized possession from Sevelle's camp.
